mapper.select: SELECT o.id, o.event_type, o.source_record_id, r.enterprise_id, r.source, r.record_type, r.title, CASE WHEN COALESCE(LOWER(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.raw_payload, '$.demo'))), 'false') NOT IN ('false', '0') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_demo, CASE WHEN r.validity_status = 'VALID' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ent_company_signal s WHERE s.source_record_id = r.id AND s.enterprise_id = r.enterprise_id AND s.expires_at IS NOT NULL AND s.expires_at < NOW()) THEN 'EXPIRED' ELSE r.validity_status END AS validity_status FROM collector_event_outbox o JOIN collector_record r ON r.id = o.source_record_id WHERE o.id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT run_id, owner_id, disposition, reason FROM agent_event_dispatch WHERE outbox_event_id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_event_dispatch(outbox_event_id, run_id, owner_id, disposition, reason) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{runId}, #{ownerId}, #{disposition}, #{reason})
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_run SET status = 'ERROR', finished_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{runId} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND created_at < NOW() - INTERVAL 15 MINUTE
